company.shortDescription: Vendy is a marketplace on WhatsApp
company.description: Vendy is a marketplace on WhatsApp. You can create a custom WhatsApp shop in 2 minutes so interested buyers can make inquiries, browse through your inventory, add to a cart, place orders with automated invoicing, and make payments, all within WhatsApp. No app download or sign-up required

productsAndServices.description: A platform that allows vendors to create storefronts on WhatsApp where customers can browse products, place orders, receive invoices, and make payments without needing to download an app.
productsAndServices.name: WhatsApp Shop

productsAndServices.description: A proprietary payment solution that enables buyers to pay vendors directly within WhatsApp using various linked bank accounts or wallets, eliminating the need for external payment apps or screenshots.
productsAndServices.name: In-App Payments

productsAndServices.description: A service that automates the delivery of both physical and digital products ordered through WhatsApp, including event tickets, online courses, and physical goods.
productsAndServices.name: Delivery Management

productsAndServices.description: A payment solution that provides customers with global access to their funds across multiple accounts or wallets, enabling payments on messaging apps like WhatsApp at any time.
productsAndServices.name: Vendy Direct

productsAndServices.description: A system that consolidates all orders and customer information in one place, enabling vendors to automate invoicing, track sales, and manage customer inquiries on WhatsApp.
productsAndServices.name: Order and Customer Management

insights.title: Funding is concentrated in the latest major round
insights.statement: The latest disclosed Pre Seed round raised $1,200,000, or 100% of reported total funding.
insights.implication: This round accounts for most reported historical financing, making it important when assessing funding-source concentration and fundraising cadence.

insights.title: Valuation increased across disclosed rounds
insights.statement: Known post-money valuation rose from $9,167,555 to $9,167,555, a 1x increase.
insights.implication: The disclosed financing history indicates a material valuation step-up between the earliest and latest rounds with known valuations.
caveats: Only rounds with a disclosed post-money valuation are compared.

insights.title: Sharp recent attention and growth momentum
insights.statement: Crunchbase scores growth at 42 (+0 over 90 days) and market heat at 82 (+0).
insights.implication: The company has recently become much more visible, but the scores should be treated as attention/activity indicators rather than revenue or clinical-performance metrics.
caveats: Crunchbase does not expose the complete weighting behind these proprietary scores.
